meta.title: SignalForge — Launch Keynote
meta.description: Product launch keynote — Bold Signal theme multi-slide proof.

slides.heading: Ship the signal. Skip the noise.
slides.lead: One orange card. One clear ask. Zero soft-pedal.

slides.heading: One board. One pulse. One owner.
slides.body: SignalForge collapses status theater into a single launch board — blockers, decisions, and the next ask in one glance. Stakeholders get one weekly broadcast, not seventeen Slack pings.
slides.aside: Route every ask to the person who can ship it — not the loudest thread.

slides.heading: From status theater to signal.
slides.left:
Standups that restate Slack.
Roadmaps nobody opens.
Decisions buried in docs.
slides.right:
One pulse per launch.
Owners, not observers.
Decisions with a timestamp.

slides.quote: We stopped performing status and started shipping.

slides.heading: Turn the volume down. Turn the signal up.
slides.lead: Start free. Invite your launch team. Feel the difference in one sprint.
